responsibility: Implementation of the GNU C++ pretty-printer for source-like rendering of C++ trees. It prints qualified and unqualified names, types, declarators, expressions, templates, concepts/constraints, requires-expressions, and other C++ syntax forms into a pretty_printer, providing the textual formatting used by diagnostics, dumps, and debugger-oriented stringification.
same_name_distinction: Contains the concrete pretty-printing routines for rendering C++ syntax from trees, including names, declarators, requires-expressions, and constraints, plus the cxx_pretty_printer method setup. Unlike cxx-pretty-print.h, it is the implementation of formatting behavior rather than the class/prototype interface.
